WITH monthly AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS ym, SUM(total_amount) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-08' THEN amt END) AS aug_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-09' THEN amt END) AS sep_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-09' THEN amt END) - MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-08' THEN amt END) AS change_amount, ROUND(CAST(((MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-09' THEN amt END) - MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-08' THEN amt END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-08' THEN amt END) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS change_percent FROM monthly LIMIT 100

WITH m AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS mon, SUM(total_amount) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1), a AS (SELECT amt, order_count FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-08'), s AS (SELECT amt, order_count FROM m WHERE mon = '2026-09') SELECT a.amt AS aug_amount, s.amt AS sep_amount, s.amt - a.amt AS change_amount, ROUND(CAST(((s.amt - a.amt) / NULLIF(a.amt, 0) * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS change_percent, a.order_count AS aug_order_count, s.order_count AS sep_order_count FROM a CROSS JOIN s LIMIT 100
